shortlist.excerpt: Detailed design for the interior of the Taste of Queens is still underway. We currently anticipate that the market (“food hall”) will be located on the elevated first floor, directly accessible and visible from the MTA gateway plaza as well as the open space.

shortlist.excerpt: The Taste of Queens is one of the community-inspired signature elements of Metropolitan Park. Envisioned during our conversations with neighbor s, this community-driven space will include approximately 30,000-square-feet open to the public for a Queens-centric food hall and gathering space that will showcase Queens’ world-renow ned cuisines, provide affordable dining options, and create a year-round community hub with space for use by local community groups.

shortlist.excerpt: Our workforce development strategy is rooted in outreach through nearly two dozen community partners, and so we see NYCHA-focused events as a natural extension of our local hiring preference. Queens residents, including NYCHA tenants, will have direct, prioritized access to the thousands of union jobs HRMP will create.

shortlist.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-responses-9.29.25-1-c.pdf
shortlist.excerpt: Our commitment is unequivocal: 100% of the Community Impact Fund will support non-profit organizations and community priorities that directly serve Corona, East Elmhurst, Flushing, and Jackson Heights – the neighborhoods closest to Metropolitan Park. shortlist.excerpt: Their plan is to deliver 479 units of 100% affordable housing in the heart of Corona. While HRMP is not the developer, we are a financial backer and community partner, and we are confident this project will advance rapidly once financing is finalized.

shortlist.excerpt: Beginning in 2026, our seven- member advisory board will oversee all char itable giving from the Community Impact Fund and ensure resources are directed to local needs. shortlist.excerpt: Our team continues to speak at Queens MWBE expos, and we view these fairs as a core part of our promise to create wealth-building opportunities for our neighbors.
